description: This is a Scala source file containing an example implementation of a Decision Tree application using Apache Spark's MLlib. It includes data loading, model training, evaluation, and command-line argument parsing for classification and regression tasks.

classes.name: DecisionTreeExample
classes.description: Main object containing the decision tree example, including parameter definitions, data loading, model training, evaluation, and command-line interface.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the application, parses command-line arguments and initiates the run process.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads dataset from specified path and format ('libsvm' or 'dense') into a DataFrame.

methods.name: loadDatasets
methods.description: Loads training and test datasets, either from files or by splitting the input data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method that sets up Spark session, loads data, trains the model, and evaluates it.

methods.name: evaluateClassificationModel
methods.description: Evaluates classification model accuracy on given data.

methods.name: evaluateRegressionModel
methods.description: Evaluates regression model performance using RMSE on given data.
